scope: Isolated manually executable upstream dependency/converter/counter feasibility and source-linked final-directive inventory. All runtime code/config/input/output test-owned; no production mutation or product implementation.
permitted_artifact_urls: Only exact hash-bound URLs in the promoted manifest. Seed candidates are in source-observations.json. New redirect hosts stop; no wildcard host or implicit mirror.

manifest_review.owner: Codex controller during explicitly activated readiness work
manifest_review.requirement: Before each stage promotion, record full exact URL/revision/size/license/digest manifest, review it within the approved hosts/budgets, and reject unknowns. Any source build, custom model code, unlisted host or material package-impact change returns to Chuck.

stages.name: metadata/graph and inventory
stages.effects: Resolve in private exported metadata; no working-lock change, install, source build or inference. If archive payload is needed to obtain metadata, stop until an explicit archive-inspection allowance and URL manifest is recorded.

stages.name: hash-pinned wheels and isolated target
stages.effects: Download/install approved compatible third-party wheels in fresh target. Build workspace wheels only from the exact private source export with separately pinned existing build tools; no source edits. Inspect OCR routes/keys and licenses before model-stage promotion. No global environment mutation or automatic model fetch.

stages.name: manifest-owned assets and offline converter probes
stages.network: exact promoted asset URLs during transfer; denied during conversion
stages.effects: Publish verified assets; run generated/supplied manifest-bound fixtures and standalone probes under limits. Supplied originals unchanged; no production command/store path or external content upload.

stages.name: embedding qualification
stages.network: Only exact local LM Studio endpoint after the bound production-offline/restart/log-separation receipt and model/counter facts pass; none otherwise.
stages.effects: At most stated embedding/capability calls for manifested test inputs in the confirmed window. No remote/paid provider, server/process management, model download/swap/load/unload or persistent store access.

stages.name: readiness report and final-directive handoff
stages.effects: Report measured facts, unsupported rules and scope deltas. No construction or new council automatically.

unbound_model_inputs.status: A3 blocked until confirmed production-offline/restart/log-separation window and exact endpoint/model/counter/input facts are bound. Existing local endpoint may be reused. Qwen remains illustrative.

excluded_effects: Model requests outside confirmed shared-LM-Studio test window; harness service/process/settings management or production application/config/store access
Dirty YAML, personal stores, .friday-old, exports or global model caches
Third-party source distributions/build scripts, executable installers, new runtime services
Remote OCR/VLM, automatic backend fallback, URL ingestion or extra formats
Live Finance/provider tests or credential use
Creating/resetting any Chroma store during A0–A4; integration store paths are reserved for later approved work

activation.boundary_preflight: REQUIRED_BEFORE_EFFECTS; explicit test paths/origins and negative controls; model window checked before every batch.

isolation.shared_asset_publish: Only promoted A2 publisher; new manifest directory from verified run-local staging; never overwrite.
isolation.test_workspace_git_ignore: Required in separately approved harness scope before generation; not changed now.
isolation.production_containment_claim: Demonstrate with negative controls and protected-state checks; Python audit is not an OS sandbox.
isolation.shared_host_resource_contention: Limits apply; zero performance impact is not claimed.
isolation.shared_input_publish: Only explicit fixture/supplied-input preparation; new manifest-named directory from run-local staging; never overwrite originals or existing inputs.
isolation.endpoint_reuse_condition: Only confirmed operator-managed test window: production stopped, server restarted, test logs separated, exact endpoint/model/input/config/manifest hashes and expiry bound.
isolation.shared_lm_studio_exception: Existing service/model assets may be reused under the window; no harness service management or model-directory mutation. Working application/env/config/store isolation remains mandatory.

manual_operation.cli_status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; publish actual commands only after implementation

input_policy.baseline: Hash-bound generated fixtures with known expected content.
input_policy.supplemental: Explicitly supplied input manifest only; read-only copies, no in-place conversion/scanning/upload.
input_policy.originals: Unchanged; content stays private unless a sanitized report is separately selected.
input_policy.embedding: Only explicitly manifested test inputs through the reused local endpoint inside the confirmed production-offline/restart/log-separation window.
